summary: לשד is the fresh moisture or sap of a living body.

senses.definition: The moisture and vitality of the body.

note:
Drafted from Psalms 32–33 audit.

Root (2026-11-21): Filed under לשד 'suck': Arabic لَسَدَ (with س for ש) is said of a lamb sucking its mother (Lane p. 2659), so לָשָׁד is the juice or moisture sucked out (Num 11:8, Psa 32:4).
